# Valuta EX

> A comprehensive real-time currency converter supporting 160+ world currencies and major cryptocurrencies with live exchange rates.

Valuta EX provides instant currency conversion for both fiat currencies and cryptocurrencies. The platform enables users to convert between any combination of world currencies, regional currencies, and digital assets like Bitcoin Cash, Cardano, and Aave with continuously updated market rates.
